notes.title: Release Date - August 4th
notes.notes:
Here's a very short update just to let you all know that Move 78 will be launching on the 4th of August. The development has taken longer than I had first planned but I now have a release candidate that I'm happy with. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397423/39133d9f3a12eeaa9fb92950a5ef36436b7844ba.png

I am very much looking forwards to getting the game into your hands.

notes.title: Development Update #1 - Beta Test
notes.notes:
First of all, I am sorry for not updating you about the development of the game for so long. I have been hard at work on it all this time and have a near content complete version of Move 78 ready. All that's left is to finish the logic for one mini-game and do a bug sweep. 

Once this is complete, my plan is to hold a beta test (I estimate this build will be ready around 1-2 weeks from now). Once I've fixed any bugs that are found during the test I will be able to set a firm release date for the game.

Here are a few new screenshots:

A little bit of information about what's new since the last update:


Characters all have multiple expressions when talking.
Logic for all but one of the mini-games is completed.
Logic for all escape room puzzles is completed.
All voice lines have been recorded and added to the game.


If you're interested in trying the full version of the game during the beta test, send me a DM over on Twitter here.

Also, if you want to ask any questions, or give feedback on the development of the game you can check out my new discord channel here here

notes.title: Demo Release Date - October 1st
notes.notes:
Demo releasing on the 1st of October.

Move 78 will be included in the upcoming Steam Next Festival. A demo will be releasing on the 1st of October that everyone will be able to download and play.

The demo will contain the beginning part of the story, the mini-tutorial escape room, and the first full escape room. See if you can successfully take Sigrid and Hunter through the mind-bending puzzles of the Police Station.
